newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil monetary base contracts 4.8 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Brazil monetary base contracts 4.8 pct in August.

text.p: Brazil's monetary base in daily average terms contracted by 4.8 percent in August compared to the end of July, or 16.3 percent in month-on-month terms, the Central Bank said in a statment.

The bank said that in July the total net public sector debt stood at 249.158 billion reais, or 34.7 percent of gross domestic product, compared with 243.632 billion reais, or 34.3 percent of GDP in June.
Net internal debt in July was 217.644 billion reais, or 30.3 percent of GDP, versus 212.851 billion reais, or 30 percent of GDP in June, the bank said.
Net external debt in July was 31.514 billion reais, or 4.4 percent of GDP, compared with 30.781 billion reais, equivalent to 4.3 percent of GDP in June.
The monetary base in August was 16.846 billion reais, compared with 17.699 billion reais in July.
